units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 5|You wait around in the spaceport in a low, columned area. Circular depressions in the ground hold pools of water, and occasionally a Successor will come along and slither into one for a few minutes before getting on with their business. After a while, you are met by what must be an envoy of House Myurej, a tall Successor wearing the same colors as their military officers, albeit in a somewhat less martial outfit. Two soldiers flank them. "Captain <last>?" they say. "How excellent to meet thee."|320|0

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 5|	Ijaset relaxes and leans against a column, looking over the nearest pool. "Probes, for the most part. They're small enough to bring to speed with a planetary coilgun, and after a couple of years go by, we get some data back. In years past, some of the nearer stars lay more connected than they are now, and we could send whole ships. But never as far as Myurej now requests us go."|345|0

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 5|	"Myurej seeks to send us to <planet>," they say. "I've been fashioned with the location and key to a hidden vault 'pon the surface. Inside, Myurej's Predecessors kept a bevy of things ineffable, but we need not retrieve much. Today, all they ask of us is a collection of jewelry contained within." They pause and let a collection of colors emerge over them. A gentle breeze whistles through the columns. "The smallest things presage the grandest journeys," they say. "Let us go to thy craft and begin with haste."|356|0

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 5|You set down the <ship> on the outskirts of one of the smaller cities on <planet>. units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 5|	Ijaset leads you, along with the two Myurej soldiers, to an area that's a curious reflection of the columned pool area of the Myurej spaceport, though here all the water has long since evaporated. The one here is larger, too, and as you walk through the forest of white pillars, it becomes more and more difficult to see back to your ship in the distance.|361|0

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 5|	Eventually, Ijaset stops on the edge of one of the depressions. "Tis here," they say, emotionless, and point directions to the two guards. They check something against a datapad they produce from their clothing, and then glide over to one of the columns, extending three arms to feel around the circumference of it. Shortly after, something clicks, and a rumbling suddenly starts below you, growing louder and louder until it stops and an aperture opens in the middle of the depression. A tunnel yawns deep into the ground.|362|0

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 5|	The four of you make your way down the tunnel, which seems to go down into the planet for kilometers. The dark metal walls grow warm to the touch, and the slippery floor proves more treacherous for you than for the Successors - you have to catch yourself on the rail several times. Eventually you come to an enormous spherical room, large enough that the far wall fades into darkness even as a shaft above you lets in an impossibly-penetrating beam of sunlight. Ringing the walls are thousands upon thousands of circular insets, each one many meters in diameter. Their centers have a glossy sheen, as if they are slightly wet.|370|0

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 5|	Ijaset confers with their datapad and leads the three of you a couple of degrees along the great room's circumference, stopping in front of one of the insets. They produce from a pocket a gilded data-sphere that they press into its face, and you watch as the golden strands encircling it lay themselves out on the front of the surface, forming a fractal web of glittering metal. When they finally stop moving, the whole face of the inset liquefies, gold and all. Behind it lies a deep circular room stacked with elegant wooden boxes. The four of you enter and Ijaset collects a few small items, most no larger than your hand. They give most to the soldiers, but reserve three or four to carry themself.|381|0

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 5|	You quickly transmit new landing coordinates for the <ship> and its repulsors kick up the dust as another building in the city is leveled. As it nears the columned area, the orbital weapon fires again, this time targeting your ship. Some of the impacts feel like they're getting closer the farther you run, but eventually you make it back to where you landed the <ship> and hurry inside with Myurej's agents right behind you.
